assembly.method: Bounded existing public JSON only; no new hashes, SQL, engine/corpus reads, tests or measurements.
assembly.referencePolicy: Only publicReference/publicReferences objects designate published companion links. Other evidence/report/ledger/log/input filenames are retained source-artifact labels, not links and not a claim that private inputs accompany this publication. Labels preserve original execution provenance. Private raw inputs are not included.
assembly.qualification: Publication wrapper and explicit links are new; original execution dates, engine/index lineage and observations are preserved. Source documents are untouched.

qualification: Contains its synthetic/history/sample evidence once; these are not final 20 September GHC index results.

evidence.purpose: Final bounded diagnostics, not an indexing benchmark or an exhaustive real-corpus precision/recall audit.

finalEngine.builtFrom: Successful full npm run build; full-build-local-proof-16k-20260919.log

bounds.proofScope: One top-level exported-symbol traversal; no cross-lookup ABSENT/SINGLETON/UNKNOWN evidence.
bounds.qualification: These bound counted visits/state/route checks, not every CPU operation or total process RSS.

method.oracle: Frozen resolver modified only in memory; used only to certify newly resolved targets after baseline exhaustion
method.exclusions: Both unresolved when baseline exhausted are counted separately, not counted as completed equivalence checks

fixture.singletonLiteralQualification: Keeping Warm local creates an early competing ID; a third case removes it to guarantee convergence.

historyRegression.qualification: Twelve fixture rows cover two engines, three variants and two APIs. They do not establish whole-corpus determinism.

ghcThreeImportedCalls.snapshotQualification: Historical completed candidate-final core index built before this final engine; fresh resolver probes neither add stored edges nor reindex it.
ghcThreeImportedCalls.flowQualification: Actual Flow comes from ToolHandler on the unchanged historical index. Fresh 3/3 target success does not replace its 0/3 rendered Flow result; final indexed-harness evidence is still required.

method.instrumentation: Identity return wrappers and counters only; answers are not independently dual-engine checked
method.witnessObserver: Removed for the singleton-bound version; diagnostic timing is not directly comparable to versions with witness maps
method.eligibility: Stored Haskell reference, visible indexed import route, exported name in another file, no same-name local node
method.selection: Evenly spaced files in metadata path order; up to 15 eligible distinct name/namespace pairs per file; round-robin sample
method.caveat: Eligibility is a conservative import candidate, not proof that the original program reference is imported

realReferenceSample.counterQualification: Oracle outcomes count calls/returns, including repeated cache or exhausted-budget returns, not independent failed lookups.
realReferenceSample.qualification: All 300 references were stored failed in the historical index and selected by import eligibility, not a representative random sample. Exact target parity is not proof of precision; no expanded old-resolver oracle certifies all new real targets.

originalSnapshotPreservation.assemblyQualification: JSON-only assembly. No SQLite, copying, hashing, source reads, profiling or resolver execution. Recorded fingerprints are reused from completed diagnostics.

limitations: The expanded frozen-resolver oracle certifies 27 new synthetic targets only, separately from the real 300-reference sample.
Diagnostic timings are intentionally omitted: no macro performance claim.
No whole-corpus precision/recall claim; final indexed graph deltas and rendered Flow remain separate evidence.
